Margaret Alvarez

Partner, New York

Margaret Alvarez is a partner in Whitfield & Grant's New York office and co-chair of the firm's Private Equity practice. She advises strategic acquirers and private equity sponsors on complex domestic and cross-border transactions across the Corporate, Mergers & Acquisitions, and Private Equity practices.

Representative matters

  • Advised a private equity sponsor on the take-private of a NASDAQ-listed software company.

Recognition

  • Chambers USA — Corporate/M&A, Chambers and Partners, 2023
  • Dealmaker of the Year, The American Lawyer, 2021

Credentials

  • J.D., Columbia Law School, 2004 — Harlan Fiske Stone Scholar
  • B.A., Economics (minor in Spanish), magna cum laude, Cornell University, 1999

Admissions

  • New York

Before joining Whitfield & Grant, Meg was an associate at Kellerman Roth LLP from 2004 to 2011.

Brightline Legal — Fearless advocacy. Modern counsel.

Daniel Okafor

Senior Associate — Chicago

When businesses find themselves in high-stakes disputes, they call Daniel. A tenacious advocate with a knack for making complex facts simple, Daniel has tried cases and argued motions across a broad range of commercial litigation and product liability matters. Clients praise his responsiveness, his creativity, and his refusal to be outworked.

Daniel serves as the pro bono coordinator for Brightline's Chicago office, where he has built partnerships with neighborhood legal-aid clinics.

Daniel earned his J.D. from Loyola University Chicago School of Law and his B.A. in Psychology from the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign. He is admitted to practice in Illinois and before the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Illinois.

To reach our litigation team, use the contact form on our Get in Touch page.
